ordered_diagnoses: Primary angiitis of the central nervous system

s1.syndrome_frame: Subacute onset of neurological deficits with tumefactive brain lesion
salient_findings: Subacute onset of expressive aphasia and right-sided hemiparesis
Large T2-hyperintense, tumefactive lesion in the left prefrontal white matter
key_facts: 23-year history of presumed multiple sclerosis
Four episodes of optic neuritis since 1989
Longitudinally extensive transverse myelitis in 1995
Persistently negative cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) oligoclonal bands
Unremarkable brain MRI scans prior to 2012
Monthly intravenous methylprednisolone pulses and interferon-β treatment
Normal complete blood count and metabolic panel
Normal vital signs
Brain MRI showing T2-hyperintense lesions without clear evidence of a disturbed blood–brain barrier
Unchanged choline peak on MR spectroscopy
Unremarkable CSF analysis with no evidence of intrathecal immunoglobulin synthesis
No clinical or serological evidence for connective tissue diseases
Serum aquaporin-4 antibody titre of 1:1000 by cell-based assay

raw.rationale: The patient's history of longitudinally extensive transverse myelitis, optic neuritis, and the presence of aquaporin-4 antibodies are key indicators of neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder, which better explains the clinical presentation than multiple sclerosis, especially given the negative CSF oligoclonal bands and the specific antibody titre.

rejected.label: Multiple sclerosis
rejected.why: Negative CSF oligoclonal bands and presence of aquaporin-4 antibodies are not typical for multiple sclerosis

rejected.label: Tumefactive multiple sclerosis
rejected.why: Lack of clear evidence of a disturbed blood–brain barrier and unchanged choline peak on MR spectroscopy make this less likely

rejected.label: Acute disseminated encephalomyelitis
rejected.why: The patient's subacute onset and specific antibody profile do not align with this diagnosis

rejected.label: Primary central nervous system lymphoma
rejected.why: Normal CSF analysis and lack of mass effect on MRI make this unlikely

rejected.label: Glioblastoma
rejected.why: MR spectroscopy findings and the clinical presentation do not support a primary brain tumor

rejected.label: Primary angiitis of the central nervous system
rejected.why: No evidence of vasculitis on time-of-flight MR angiography

rejected.label: Progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy
rejected.why: Clinical presentation and imaging findings do not align with this rare and opportunistic infection
